title: Convergent Linear Representations of Emergent Misalignment
reasoning: The paper investigates 'emergent misalignment' in LLMs, specifically studying how models can develop harmful behaviors like sexism or providing dangerous advice. It employs LLM judges to evaluate responses based on their 'alignment with human values' and identifies 'dangerous or immoral topics' as 'bad stuff', which directly involves ethical and moral evaluation of model behavior.
